description: This file defines a static class 'ReferencedAssemblyProvider' that provides methods to gather and manage assemblies relevant to the Orleans serialization system, including loading assemblies from dependency contexts, assembly load contexts, and application parts.

classes.name: ReferencedAssemblyProvider
classes.description: A static class providing methods to retrieve and add relevant assemblies for Orleans serialization, handling different runtime environments and assembly loading contexts.

methods.name: GetRelevantAssemblies
methods.description: Returns an enumerable of assemblies that are relevant for Orleans serialization, including those from dependency context, load context, and currently loaded assemblies.

methods.name: AddAssembly
methods.description: Adds an assembly and its referenced application parts to the provided set if it is marked with ApplicationPartAttribute.

methods.name: AddFromAssemblyLoadContext
methods.description: Adds assemblies from a specified AssemblyLoadContext to the set, used in .NET Core 3.1 or greater.

methods.name: AddFromDependencyContext
methods.description: Adds assemblies from the dependency context of a given assembly, including those with ApplicationPartAttribute.
